div.head: Marianne Moore Library Index
div.p: The Marianne Moore Library Index is a detailed catalogue of the personal library of Marianne Moore and her immediate family, based on the volumes preserved at the Rosenbach Museum and Library in Philadelphia. As both a record of Moore’s private scholarship and a tool for research, the index offers a rare glimpse into the poet’s intellectual landscape, reading practices, and literary influences. Users can explore inscriptions, annotations, and enclosures, and gain insight into Moore’s unique bibliographic practice of using grangerized volumes to organize printed ephemera by topic, author, or context. The index currently includes over 2,600 volumes of printed books and pamphlets, covering subjects ranging from poetry and philosophy to natural science and children’s literature. Due to the scale of this project, some components remain in progress. Moore’s collection of LPs and periodicals will soon be added, along with all information currently marked with ellipses in brackets. Researchers interested in specific annotations or enclosures can refer to the call number column to locate the original items in the Rosenbach’s holdings.

This project has been developed by Emma Felin, Cristanne Miller, Chelsie Malyszek, Chiaki Bems, Holly Ponce, Juniper Johnson, and Nikolaus Wasmoen, with archival support from the Rosenbach Museum and Library. Researchers with additional details regarding enclosures in specific volumes are encouraged to contact Cristanne Miller at ccmiller@buffalo.edu or submit information through the MMDA’s contact form. The index will be updated periodically.
Click on a column head to sort the table of contents according to that feature or enter a search term into the search box to filter the displayed entries.
To download the full MM Library Index as a CSV file, visit MMDA Box.
